items.text: Confirm your business name registration and certificate are on record
Confirm your tax registrations and keep records of income and expenses
If you employ staff, confirm which employer registrations and contributions apply to you
If you collect personal data, document how it is used, protected and kept
Keep company registration documents and shareholder and director records up to date
Confirm that annual filings with the registry are being made
Confirm your tax registrations and keep records of income and expenses
Check whether financial reporting requirements apply to your company
If you employ staff, confirm which employer registrations and contributions apply to you
If you collect personal data, document how it is used, protected and kept
Keep the constitution, trustee records and registration documents up to date
Confirm annual filing obligations with the registry
Confirm your tax registration and reporting position
If you employ staff, confirm which employer registrations and contributions apply to you
If you collect personal data, document how it is used, protected and kept
Confirm whether your activity needs a licence or approval from a sector regulator
Check financial reporting expectations for your type of business
Review user terms and privacy documentation for your product
Check land use, planning and building approvals before projects commence
Check product registration and labelling requirements for regulated products
Check product standards requirements for what you make
Check product and facility registration requirements
Check product standards requirements
Check whether the goods you sell need registration or standards approval
Check registration requirements for processed or packaged products

disclaimer: This checklist is a starting point, not legal advice. Whether each item applies depends on your activity and status, and requirements change. SCS can confirm what applies to your business.
